name: f5-geometric-curvature
description: Separates what this layer's own 'is the Curvature Depth Index a geometric curvature?' question actually resolves into: two real, explicit transforms of an already-frozen CDIx/CDIh value -- a linear visual-depth rescaling (profundidade_visual = a * CDI(t), a > 0, GDX_HNF_VISDEPTH_RUN/VALUE) and a Gaussian dip curve (y(s) = -CDI(t) * exp(-s^2/(2*sigma^2)), sigma > 0, GDX_HNF_DEPTHCURVE_RUN/VALUE, storing only the curve's real deepest point) -- and a permanent, schema-enforced refusal to compute a true Riemannian scalar curvature (no manifold/metric/connection is defined anywhere in this project's own pipeline). Never recomputes CDIx or CDIh itself.
